name: move
doc: Move one tile in the given direction.

name: mine
doc: Mine the tile the miner stands on. Returns a dict with ok, and reason or ore when relevant.

name: peek
doc: Return the ore on the current tile, None if empty, or 'unknown' if the ore is locked.

name: position
doc: Return the miner position as (x, y).

name: sell
doc: Sell the whole inventory at the base and return the money gained.

name: unload
doc: Move the drone inventory into the base warehouse and return {moved, left}.

name: stock
doc: Return the warehouse contents and capacity as {items, capacity, used, free}.

name: sell_stock
doc: Sell items from the warehouse at market prices and return the money gained.

name: price
doc: Return the current market price of an unlocked item, or None.

name: prices
doc: Return a dict of current market prices for every unlocked item.

name: price_history
doc: Return up to n recent price samples for an unlocked item, or None.

name: inventory
doc: Return the inventory as a dict of ore id to count.

name: scan
doc: Scan for ore within radius tiles. Returns a list of (dx, dy, ore_id) for non-empty tiles.
cost: 1 + radius ticks (radius capped by the scanner)
example: for dx, dy, ore in scan(2): ...

name: stats
doc: Return per-ore mining statistics as {ore: {'attempts': n, 'successes': m}}.

name: buy_upgrade
doc: Buy the next level of the given upgrade and return the new level.

name: wait
doc: Wait for ticks (1 to 600) without doing anything else.

name: tick
doc: Return the current game tick.

name: distance
doc: Return the Chebyshev distance from the base at (0, 0).

name: biome
doc: Return the id of the biome under the miner.

name: ore_info
doc: Return {id, name, tier, hardness, base_value, regen_ticks} for a known ore, or None when it is unknown or locked. The mining probability is never included.

name: inspect
doc: Return {ore, mineable, reason, regrows_in} for the current tile.

name: submit_estimate
doc: Submit an estimate p for the mining probability of an ore after at least 100 attempts. Allows three submissions per ore and returns {ok, close}.

name: recipes
doc: Return {recipe_id: {id, name, inputs, outputs, ticks, unlocked, unlocked_by}} for every refinery recipe.

name: refine
doc: Start a refinery job at the base. The inputs are consumed immediately; returns {ok, recipe, times, duration, finish_tick}.

name: refinery
doc: Return the running refinery jobs as a list of {recipe, times, ticks_left, progress, blocked, outputs}.

name: contracts
doc: Return the open delivery contracts as a list of {id, item, quantity, reward, deadline, ticks_left}.

name: deliver
doc: Deliver a contract from the warehouse at the base and return the reward money.
